title: Constant-ring semilinear system operations and normalized evaluation mates
statement:
Fix a universe $u$, with schemes in universe $u$ and rings in universe $u+1$. Let $C:\mathbb N\to\operatorname{CommRing}$ be any sequence of commutative rings with homomorphisms $\tau_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$, and let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. On its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $B_{n,X}=\underline{C_n}_X$ and $\tau_{n,X}=\underline{\tau_n}_X$, using the constant sheaf functor [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Define $B_{\bullet,X}$ on the vertical sequence site by $B_{\bullet,X}(n,V)=B_{n,X}(V)$, with the given horizontal ring transitions. Define $\mathscr S_X$ to be the strict semilinear system category [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]: its objects are sheaves of $B_{n,X}$-modules $M_n$ with $B_{n+1,X}$-linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{\tau_{n,X}}M_n$, and its morphisms are componentwise module maps commuting with these transitions. Write $D_X=D(\mathscr S_X)$ for its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

For a scheme map $f:X\to Y$, use the sequence-site functor $(n,V)\mapsto(n,V\times_YX)$ and the structural ring map uniquely characterized at every $(n,V)$ by the canonical constant-section map $B_{n,Y}(V)\to B_{n,X}(V\times_YX)$. Define $f_{*,\bullet}:\mathscr S_X\to\mathscr S_Y$ to be module-sheaf direct image with this ring map, and $f^*_\bullet$ to be its left adjoint, with its ordinary adjunction unit and counit retained. Set $P_f=Df^*_\bullet$, the exact termwise localization, $R_f=Rf_{*,\bullet}$, the total right-derived functor on systems, and take $P_f\dashv R_f$ to be the adjunction induced by that ordinary adjunction. For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion], define $j_{!,\bullet}$ as the left adjoint of $j^*_\bullet$ (the sheafified extension-by-zero construction [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]), retaining its ordinary unit and counit, and set $J_j=Dj_{!,\bullet}$.

For $n\in\mathbb N$, let $E_n^0:\mathscr S_X\to\mathcal T_X(C_n)$ be evaluation $M\mapsto M_n$ followed by the constant strict tower, where $\mathcal T_X(C_n)$ and its ordinary and derived operations are those of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], and set $E_n=DE_n^0$. Specify the ordinary direct-image comparison $f_{*,n}^{\mathcal T}\circ E_{n,X}^0\cong E_{n,Y}^0\circ f_{*,\bullet}$ by the identity on every underlying component section $M_n(V\times_YX)$. Define $a_{f,n}:f_n^{*,\mathcal T}\circ E_{n,Y}^0\to E_{n,X}^0\circ f_\bullet^*$ as the ordinary adjunction transpose [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of the inverse of this specified comparison, and use its inverse isomorphism after exact localization to define $E_{n,X}\circ P_f\cong G_{f,n}\circ E_{n,Y}$. Define $E_{n,Y}\circ R_f\to R_{f,n}\circ E_{n,X}$ as the derived adjunction mate of the inverse of this last comparison. These definitions retain the specified section and adjunction normalizations, with no hypothesis of flat coefficient transitions, finiteness of the rings, boundedness of complexes, or faithfulness of derived evaluation. The site object universe is $u+1$, its morphism universe is $u$, the ring/module universe is $u+1$, and the derived localization universe is $u+2$.
